title: Reader votes train only the tenant's own Cyclotron, opt-in; shared model explored later
description:
What: default off; a tenant may opt in to training its own Cyclotron from reader votes. A shared model trained across tenants is not built; a short design note records the question for later.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Votes on tenant A never reach tenant B's model
  Given both tenants collect votes
  When A's Cyclotron retrains
  Then B's data is not read
